name: Header
description: Site header: brand (logo and/or name), navigation and an optional call-to-action button.

layout.description: split: brand left, navigation right. centered: brand above centred navigation. brand-left: navigation right after the brand.

tone.description: Surface with a bottom border, dark (ink) background, or transparent over the hero that follows.

position.description: Sticky keeps the header at the top while scrolling.

menu.description: How submenus open on wide screens: a list under the item (flyout) or a wide panel of columns (mega). Submenus nest to any depth.

tagline.description: A line under the site name, as themes that print the tagline in the header do (site.tagline).

brandSize.description: The site name's size where the source theme sets its own (a CSS length).

bordered.description: The line under the bar on the default tone; false where the source's header draws none.

brandWeight.description: The site name's weight where the source theme sets its own (a CSS font-weight).

brandTracking.description: The site name's letter-spacing where the source theme sets its own (a CSS length, or normal).

offsetTop.description: Space above the bar where the source's header has its own (a CSS length).

padTop.description: Space inside the bar above its content where the source's header has its own (a CSS length).

padBottom.description: Space inside the bar below its content where the source's header has its own (a CSS length).

linkNav.description: The navigation in the site's link colour, as themes that colour every link do.

showName.description: Show the site name next to the logo.

action.description: Header button, shown on wide screens.

search.description: A search field in the bar: a GET form to the site's search page (default /search); below the bar on a phone.

navLabel.description: Accessible name of the navigation (ui-strings nav.label).

a11y: One <header> landmark; the brand link is named by the site name when only the logo shows. Navigation as in nav.
